text: Si saɗteende memii sirkooɓe ɓen, immorde e ñawu maa baasal maa kokke, ɓe nodda Joomi maɓɓe tun, ruttitorgol e Makko yankinagol moolo e makko, fii no O huncirana ɓe saɗteende maɓɓe. Hooti si O yurmiraama ɓe huncangol ɓe nden saɗteende, e jaka fedde e maɓɓe hino yiltitoo e sirkangol kafida Joomi mun e goɗɗum goo ka du'agol.
